reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it actively promotes OneCoin as a cryptocurrency business opportunity, promises that token portfolios can double in less than 10 weeks, and urges viewers to register immediately. It also encourages recruitment by offering rewards for building a team and emphasizes limited positions, creating a direct solicitation built around token-return and downline-income claims.

citations.quote: OneCoin is a on market thru educational program
double your tokens
building your own team for which you can receive a solid reward
the number of positions at this stage is limited

opening.argument: The presentation uses opportunity and educational language, but it does not expressly promise that viewers will profit or state that participation is risk-free. It describes cryptocurrency as a market and frames participation as something users undertake after studying and improving their skills. The careful reading is therefore an invitation to evaluate a new financial opportunity, not a guarantee of results: viewers are told they can study, track their business growth, and trade when ready. Claims about possible token growth should be understood as promotional possibilities within a market context, not assurances that every participant will succeed.

citations.quote: OneCoin is a on market thru educational program were you are studying game strategy on the market and profit trading with crypto currencies.
Once you feel ready to trade cryptocurrency go on the exchange and trade on onecoin.
track your business growth

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited phrases describe a training program and a possible token feature, but they do not establish that returns are guaranteed, that viewers must pay a specific amount, or that anyone will actually receive money. “Solid reward” is unspecified, and “limited” positions can describe launch timing rather than deception. The opening also treats promotional language as proof of a scam without showing that the educational and trading components are fictitious.

citations.quote: OneCoin is a on market thru educational program
building your own team for which you can receive a solid reward
We are at the stage of soft launch, and the number of positions at this stage is limited.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The presentation does more than mention uncertainty: it says token portfolios can be doubled in less than ten weeks, tells viewers to register immediately, and connects rewards to building a team. Educational wording does not neutralize those concrete inducements. The absence of a stated purchase amount or exact reward structure does not erase the explicit solicitation and earnings claims.

citations.quote: double your tokens
This means you can twice your number of tokens in less than 10 weeks.
Use this opportunity and register right now.
building your own team for which you can receive a solid reward

opening.argument: The video's central framing is instructional: it explains how the program works, describes learning packages and an academy, and outlines how a participant can study before trading. That is consistent with an educational or operational demonstration of a cryptocurrency platform. The speaker explains access to a private office, learning materials, token use, exchange activity, and business-growth tracking. A polished presenter and financial graphics do not change the subject into a scam; they are presentation devices for explaining a technology and its associated training process.

citations.quote: Token allows you to trade on our site with thousands of other participants, improve your skills and get the knowledge that you have acquired in our academy.
you will get access to your private office where you will be able to study the OnePoint concept, get access to the learning packages
track your business growth and read the latest companies' news!
Once you feel ready to trade cryptocurrency go on the exchange and trade on onecoin.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material educational does not answer its actual call to action. The video does not merely teach cryptocurrency concepts; it directs viewers to register, promote the coin, and build a team for compensation. The training description is therefore part of the sales pitch, not evidence that the presentation is a neutral tutorial. Its explanation of platform functions also does not verify that the advertised opportunity operates as described.

citations.quote: Active participation in ONE Network gives you the opportunity to promote ONE Coin coins building your own team for which you can receive a solid reward.
Use this opportunity and register right now.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The instructional packaging is precisely what makes the solicitation persuasive, but the relevant conduct remains explicit: viewers are encouraged to trade tokens, join the network, recruit a team, and register immediately. A tutorial can still promote a fraudulent scheme. The cited academy and private-office language shows branding and claimed functionality, not independent instruction or proof that the opportunity is legitimate.

citations.quote: get access to the learning packages
building your own team for which you can receive a solid reward
Use this opportunity and register right now.

opening.argument: On the supplied record, the offering can be read as a paid educational and trading service with a referral-style business promotion. The description identifies a registration destination, while the narration explains access to learning packages, an exchange, tokens, and a private office. Crucially, the record does not specify a required deposit, a guaranteed cash return, a credential request, or the actual amount or structure of any reward. “Building your own team” may describe ordinary affiliate or referral compensation, and the evidence does not establish that recruitment is the sole product or that a loss outcome is promised.

citations.quote: http://www.onecoin.eu/signup/roland999
get access to the learning packages
go on the exchange and trade on onecoin.
building your own team for which you can receive a solid reward

rebuttal.rebuttal: The missing details do not make the observed mechanism ordinary. The video explicitly links participation to doubling tokens and links team-building to a reward, then uses urgency to solicit registration. Whether the reward amount is specified is immaterial to the existence of the recruitment incentive. Calling the destination a service also does not establish that the service is genuine or that the promoted token has real value.

citations.quote: This means you can twice your number of tokens in less than 10 weeks.
building your own team for which you can receive a solid reward
Use this opportunity and register right now.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The service framing omits the strongest evidence: the program claims tokens can double in under ten weeks and offers rewards for building a team. Those are not merely ordinary descriptions of access or retail features. The absence of a deposit amount or credential request is not exculpatory, because the relevant evidence is the promised token increase, recruitment-based reward, and immediate registration pressure.
